主要内容: WestRock Company (NYSE:WRK) reported strong results for its fiscal third quarter, which ended June 30, 2015. The company announced that RockTenn Company and MeadWestvaco Corporation had completed a strategic combination, becoming wholly owned subsidiaries of WestRock. For the quarter ended June 30, 2015, RockTenn's net sales were $2.54 billion, with segment income of $295 million, compared to $263 million in the prior year quarter. RockTenn's earnings were $1.10 per diluted share, including $13 million of restructuring and other costs, with adjusted earnings at $1.15 per diluted share. MeadWestvaco's net sales were $1.42 billion, with segment income of $207 million, compared to $193 million in the prior year quarter. WestRock highlighted progress in synergy capture and go-to-market strategies, with previously identified $300 million of merger-related synergies. The company set a total productivity and cost reduction goal of $1.0 billion, before inflation, to be realized by September 30, 2018. WestRock also established a stockholder-friendly capital allocation strategy, including a target normalized Leverage Ratio of 2.25x–2.50x, an annualized dividend of $1.50 per share, and a share repurchase authorization of up to 40 million shares. The merged U.S. qualified defined benefit pension plans of RockTenn and MeadWestvaco resulted in expected contribution savings of approximately $550 million cumulatively through 2024. Steve Voorhees, CEO of WestRock, stated that the combined performance in the June quarter was outstanding and that the company was executing well to create a global industry leader in consumer and corrugated packaging. WestRock reported strong results for its fiscal 2015 third quarter, with combined segment sales reaching $2,014 million, up 11% compared to the prior year quarter. The Corrugated Packaging segment saw a 4% increase in corrugated box shipments, with RockTenn's EBITDA margins improving by 200 basis points to 19.4%. MeadWestvaco's Brazil corrugated box shipments rose 15%, and EBITDA margins improved by 530 basis points to 28.7%. The Consumer Packaging segment reported combined sales of $1,713 million, with RockTenn achieving record fiscal third quarter sales and operating profit. MeadWestvaco's Food and Beverage sales were relatively flat but up 2% on a constant currency basis, while Home, Health and Beauty sales declined 12% due to the disposal of the European Beauty and Personal Care Folding operation.
